title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00009 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:35: Continued RIH from 2050 mmd to hud at 2830 mmd. Performed PU every 500 m. Depth PUW 500 3000 1000 3530 1500 4500 2000 5200 2500 6200
00:35 - 02:10: RIH with tractor activated from 2830 m to 3490 mmd. Average running speed 9 m/min.
02:10 - 04:45: Correlated multiple times across interval 3525 3470 mmd. Experience stick-slip and high tension maximum 9500 lbs), which affected logging quality.
04:45 - 05:05: Positioned straddle with top element at 3474. 5 mmd. Verified depth with petec and picked up 1. 5 m to 3473 mmd to have straddle elements symmetrical over perforations.
05:05 - 05:35: Set straddle across interval 3473. 0 3483. 5 mmd. Lost appr. 3400 lbs on surface tension, head tension dropped 1000 lbs. Completed setting sequence and tagged straddle with tractor to verify set. WHP 77 bar.
05:35 - 07:40: POOH from 3484mmd to surface. Average pulling speed 30 m/min.
07:40 - 09:00: Closed and inflow tested HMV and SV. WHP 80 bar.
09:00 - 10:00: Closed DHSV and bled of pressure above through PWV.
10:00 - 11:45: Inflow tested DHSV to 0. 01 bar 30 min
11:45 - 12:15: Closed HMV and purged lubricator through XT-CROSS with n2.
12:15 - 12:35: Performed tool-box talk prior to l/d BHA on drillfloor.
12:35 - 13:10: Broke lubricator. L/d BHA on drillfloor.
13:10 - 13:40: L/d upper lubricator section and GIH to catwalk.
13:40 - 13:45: Performed tool-box talk prior to lifting riser of well.
13:45 - 14:40: Disconnected and lifted lower lubricator section above WL BOP to drillfloor. Lifted WL BOP from hatchdeck to PCE container. Lifted riser to cantilever deck.
14:40 - 16:15: Installed top cap and KW cap. Rewound all BOP and PCE hoses. Installed permanent hatch.
16:15 - 17:45: Leak tested top cap and KW cap to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Meanwhile split lubricator on drillfloor.
17:45 - 18:45: Checked valve status with production operator and cleaned wellhead area. Prepared handover documention and handed well back to production dep.
18:45 - 00:00: Packe
